financial_event_proof_valid.name: financial_event_proof_valid
financial_event_proof_valid.value: ("financial_event"."kind" in ('intent_created','intent_canceled') and "financial_event"."provider" = 'planning' and "financial_event"."verification" = 'user-planning') or ("financial_event"."kind" not in ('intent_created','intent_canceled') and "financial_event"."provider" = 'paypal-sandbox' and "financial_event"."verification" in ('provider-api','verified-webhook') and "financial_event"."order_id" is not null)

paypal_operation_valid.name: paypal_operation_valid
paypal_operation_valid.value: "paypal_operation"."kind" in ('order', 'capture', 'refund') and "paypal_operation"."status" in ('sending', 'uncertain', 'pending', 'verified', 'failed') and "paypal_operation"."requested_minor" between 1 and 500
